title: Element of a number field
description: Value is (sum num_i * alpha^i) / den in the power basis 1, alpha, ..., alpha^(n-1). The power basis is fixed by the defining polynomial and so is always available; an integral basis is derived-expensive and may be uncomputed. The ambient field is the record's subject unless the use site pins one explicitly.

num.description: power-basis coordinates, length = degree. policy: primary.
